joinquant_official_10_30_backtest.metric_scope_note: Official Sharpe/Sortino use JoinQuant platform conventions; do not compare them numerically with local or Research zero-risk-free ratios.

bias_checks.future_data: Signals use observation_date or earlier; all 643 matched weekly executions follow their observation date.
bias_checks.survivorship: Local lifecycle filters include historically delisted ETFs; JoinQuant rebuilds the ETF master at each historical date.
bias_checks.tracking_index_point_in_time: JoinQuant uses FUND_INVEST_TARGET pub_date/start_date/end_date filters. Local tracking_target is a current static profile and is not strict PIT.
bias_checks.price_adjustment: Both paths use pre-adjusted/continuous prices for signals; lagged raw money turnover is used for ADV.
bias_checks.execution: Local and JoinQuant Research paths use next-session open proxies. The official strategy was separately run with Monday 10:30 platform scheduling.
bias_checks.capacity: Strict stress tests cap every risk trade at 0.5% of lagged ADV20; the frozen baseline only caps target risk holdings and can exceed this on forced reductions.
